description:
A NashHash26 Hash Campout
Come join us for 4 days of hashing over the 2026 July 4th holiday weekend. We’ve secured a private campground a couple hours from Indianapolis, IN just across the Ohio border. Camp Graham is excited to host us in Clarksville, OH.
What do you get for your rego?
5 Trails
Beer Mile
All the beer, seltzers, cider and NA liquids your heart desires
3 Meals a Day, plenty of orange food, and midnight snacks – and if you know anything about Indy we like to feed people.
Swag (TBD)
Dance Parties
Costume Contest
Talent Show – MC’d by our own 2Fists2Furrious
OlympDicks and Highland Games
Camp Graham Details
Camp Graham is a 4H campground in Clarksville, OH and has previously hosted hash events. The campground is on 70 acres of rolling Ohio Valley woodlands. The campsite features 14 primitive cabins.
Cabins include bunk beds and electricity, but do not have A/C or bathrooms. There are two shower houses near the cabins with full bathrooms. Cabins will be assigned ahead of the event. MisMan will ask for bunkmate requests at a later time. Cabin assignments will be posted ahead of the event to leave ample time if changes need to be made.
Temporary campsites (no electric) for tents and RVs will be available for an additional campsite fee. If you are staying in an RV or tent with a group, please have only one member of your group select the RV or Tent accommodation option that includes the fee. There is an additional selection if you are planning to stay with someone in an RV or tent. The venue is charging by the campsite, so please make selections carefully.
Primitive RV Campsite Fee: $125
Tent Campsite Fee: $45
The additional campsite fees are per tent or RV. The campground does not hold a license for tent and RV camping and they have to apply for a temporary campsite license for the weekend for us. They have an additional charge per temporary campsite in addition to the full campground rental costs that won’t be covered by your rego. Group cabin spots are included in the original rego price.
All campers will have access to the shower houses and indoor bathrooms. There are also portable toilets near the tent camp area for late night emergencies.
The campground include a Mess Hall with industrial kitchen, air conditioning and additional bathrooms. There is also an outdoor recreation hall that is covered and has electricity. The campground has a swimming pool that will be open while manned by hashers that are certified lifeguards. There are also two bonfire pits with amphitheater seating.
The campground manager does stay on site and will be on property all weekend. However, he is aware of our hashy shenanigans and will keep to himself the majority of the time.
Themes
:Thursday – Summer Camp Nostalgia:
Camp Graham is a classic kids summer camp so let’s kick off the weekend by paying tribute to our favorite summer camp classics. Feeling like a Wet Hot American Summer with your best 80’s attire? Or maybe you want to freak people out with Camp Crystal Lake vibes. Channel your inner unhinged Ben Stiller and show up as Tony Pervis in Heavyweights.
:Friday – Pest Friends Forever:
Hash campouts wouldn’t be complete without a few bug bites. Bring out your best insect or vermin getup for the costume contest.
:Saturday – Primal Rave:
Tap into your primal side for the Saturday night neon rave dance party.
What to Bring
Tent (if tent camping)
Bedding – bunk beds only have mattresses
Sunscreen

Costumes
